source_policy: 下列旧结构差异取实际解码源码；新目标ID/导入去重为项目设计，不将缺值默认或旧解码默认沿用到未知版本。

normalization_steps.add_loadout: rank0 fuxian_sword only if old stage says owned; rank0 menial_robe; empty equipment bag
transfer exact two ranks to explicit sword/armor; sword only if source stage owns it; empty bag
transfer exact ranks to sword/armor; source stage determines sword ownership

normalization_steps.action: read original full fields, never infer new missing data

import_identity.repeated_same_source_same_profile: show prior imported character/result; no second role/items
import_identity.new_source_bytes_same_old_role: explicit distinct import preview, never automatically merge/overwrite old imported role
import_identity.canonical_json_equivalence_not_guarantee: byte-different source has different digest, always show preview
import_identity.role_id_derivation: SHA256 UTF8 profile_id + ASCII0 separator + source_digest; prefix legacy_ and full hex digest
import_identity.instance_id_derivation: SHA256 UTF8 imported_role_id + ASCII0 separator + original_container_path_and_index; prefix legacy_item_ and full hex digest
import_identity.same_source_identical_items_at_different: distinct instances; never deduplicate by definition/rank
import_identity.receipt_and_role_commit: one profile transaction; failure leaves old target/source intact; retry same receipt never grants again

target_role: Fang Chen sword preset, rank0 route unselected; do not run22new-character grants

training_gate_daily_conversion.accepted_sources: only four explicitly accepted schema/content pairs
training_gate_daily_conversion.policy: no historical task tokens or delivery rewards; explicit new ledger, never missing-field repair for new formats

training_gate_buff_conversion.accepted_sources: only the four explicitly accepted schema/content version pairs
training_gate_buff_conversion.policy: known legacy source has no training grant history; initialize empty ledger explicitly, never invent historical buffs or claims
training_gate_buff_conversion.world_clock: explicitly created target world starts training_gate_clock_steps at0; joining an existing world uses its authoritative persisted clock
training_gate_buff_conversion.new_format_missing_fields: reject; this legacy conversion is never a load repair

warehouse_silver_conversion.carried_silver: preserve exact old silver through existing mapping; never deposit it implicitly

critical_open_mappings: whole schema5 profile strict shape and all character subsystem references/activities/instance validation, beyond receipt and retained progress components
validation: unknown/mismatched version pair, unknown fields, missing required old fields, malformed ranks/state/counters/settings/position fail entire import. No DB writes, no user save mutation, no importing a partial role just to pass later stages.

experience_conversion.basis: existing Rust decoder validates all accepted schemas against the current preserved liuli0.6 rules; this is the explicitly supported import baseline, not proof all historical private configurations had this curve
experience_conversion.method: for legacy level L<10, target_xp = target_start[L] + floor((source_xp-old_start[L])*target_cost[L]/(old_start[L+1]-old_start[L])); source5000 old level10 maps exactly to target level10 start
experience_conversion.preserves: decoded old integer level and within-level rational progress to target XP precision; original total_exp preserved in import provenance, not asserted numerically unchanged
experience_conversion.custom_legacy_curve: explicitly unsupported without a separately versioned and verified import profile; never guess from HP or skills

point_migration.level_award_spans: if L>1, [2,L] kind legacy_import_skip, 0 ordinary/ascension normal award; none for L1
point_migration.normal_rules_after_import: new future levels follow current table; no retroactive new-system points for imported levels
point_migration.reason: old saves have no new qigong/ascension pool, preserving historical martial levels does not award new pools

source_validation.hp: integer1..(120+30*(legacy_level-1)); schema1..4 source validation rejects dead0 HP, never rescues it
source_validation.stamina: finite numeric0..100 per preserved baseline; parse original JSON numeric token as decimal/rational for preview, not accidental language int conversion

hp.target_max_hp: compute fully validated imported sword role at converted level/rank0, real imported equipment/sect/skills and explicit overrides; never use new-character template
hp.rounding_reason: positive old HP remains positive; ratio error less than1 target HP; not a refill
hp.invalid_source: reject before conversion; never clamp bad old HP

stamina.rounding_reason: explicit fractional quantization to integer rule, loss strictly less than1; preserve original token and show before/after in preview
stamina.normal_regeneration_after_import: 23 contract, never initialize to full or recover offline time

mana.target: full derived current mana maximum; explicitly new resource initialization, not proof old mana existed

resource_conversion.other_resources: no rage/chord/shield/charge sources in old snapshot; initialize explicitly absent/0 for sword class, do not read combat effects from current play session
resource_conversion.no_new_grants: no health potion, XP, points, starter gear or quest reward on conversion
resource_conversion.commit_policy: original and converted resource values recorded with source digest in same import receipt; preview/confirmation precedes actual import; retry repeats original result not new healing

receipt_policy.storage_unit: same profile JSON atomic commit as imported role, not external index/DB
receipt_policy.strict_fields: schema validates shape only; arithmetic/references/deduplication require semantic validation
receipt_policy.version_pair: exact accepted_version_pairs; independent enum membership insufficient
receipt_policy.source_numeric_token: parse whole original JSON number grammar, finite0..100, rational floor must equal target_stamina; no eval/code/nonnumeric text
receipt_policy.conversion_relations: source level/maxHP, targetXP and HP ceiling validated with pinned import-profile v1, not mutable present role. Imported sword rank0,no new HP qigong/overrides and old equipment/sect have no maxHP bonus; targetMaxHP=133+7*(sourceLevel-1). Old skills validated against source level. Later role configuration/level/equipment changes never rewrite historical conversion.
receipt_policy.source_paths: canonical original normalized schema4 paths, each once; two distinct paths keep distinct ID. ID re-derived using receipt role ID and path; no mutable current container indices
receipt_policy.present_role_reference: exactly one current role with matching identity; target instances may later be moved/sold/consumed, so receipt is initial provenance, never recreates missing current items
receipt_policy.deleted_role_reference: no current role under target ID; keep tombstone after explicit role deletion; replay reports already imported then deleted, never silently resurrects
receipt_policy.revision: positive commit revision <= current profile revision, no duplicate or future imports
receipt_policy.receipt_updates: after original commit immutable except explicit present->deleted tombstone; live progression never rewrites conversion snapshot
receipt_policy.same_origin_changed_bytes: explicit separate preview, no auto-merge as previously defined
receipt_policy.receipt_unknown_versions_or_bad_relation: reject profile/import; never rebuild index by guessing current role contents
